description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageService class in a Human Resource Management system, responsible for managing employee language data via DAO (Data Access Object). It includes functionality to instantiate and retrieve the EmployeeLanguageDao instance.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageService
classes.description: Service class providing access to EmployeeLanguageDao, manages the DAO instance for employee language data.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeLanguageDao instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.
